facts.fact: Flora 因房屋水损修葺暂住 Liz 家（Clouds 家），同时在该家的烹饪学校工作
facts.anchor: I appreciate Liz letting me stay here while the builders empty my bank account repairing the flood damage to my house

facts.fact: Dr Russo 判定自费否则孤独症与 ADHD 评估至少等三年
facts.anchor: Dr Russo told me that unless I pay privately, I’ll be waiting at least three years for autism and ADHD assessments

facts.fact: Flora 已修遍各种课程（花艺、一级键盘、初级西班牙语等）仍没找到一生的事业
facts.anchor: You’ve already perfected flower arranging, grade one keyboard, Spanish for beginners, and numerous others

facts.fact: 她内心反复问父母问了她一生的问题：Why are you like this? What is wrong with you?
facts.anchor: I silently ask the two questions I’ve bullied myself with after hearing my parents ask them all my life

facts.fact: 约会 app 上她滑掉了爱情骗子 Jack Edwards，自称喜欢年长男人但不爱偷钱的 love bomber
facts.anchor: I swipe away the guy who nearly got money out of me—Jack Edwards, total romance fraudster who talked like he was twenty years older than his presumably doctored photos suggested

facts.fact: 匹配对象 Pete 被发现正在她自己的卧室里自拍发来——他是修她房子的施工队成员
facts.anchor: Pete is in my bedroom, holding his dick like he’s a competition winner at a small-town cucumber grower event. He’s part of the team fixing my house!

facts.fact: 耳机声音误切到外放，全家人听到视频声音，Liz 打圆场把 Jem 拖走
facts.anchor: I fumble, accidentally switching the sound to the speaker

facts.fact: Jem 告知 Garett 与 Ruby 都病倒，Flora 今晚必须主讲烹饪课而非辅助
facts.anchor: Ruby has caught it as well. You need to run the class at the school tonight rather than assist.

facts.fact: 章末 Flora 发誓再也不回这栋房子
facts.anchor: I can’t return to this house again.
